articles.title: Hello World
articles.english: Hello, my name is John. I am from England. I like to read books and play football. Today is a beautiful day. The sun is shining and the birds are singing.
articles.chinese: 你好，我叫约翰。我来自英国。我喜欢读书和踢足球。今天是美好的一天。阳光灿烂，鸟儿在唱歌。

sentences.english: Hello, my name is John.
I am from England.
I like to read books and play football.
Today is a beautiful day.
The sun is shining and the birds are singing.

articles.title: My Family
articles.english: I have a big family. My father is a doctor. My mother is a teacher. I have two brothers and one sister. We live in a small house near the park. Every weekend, we go to the park together.
articles.chinese: 我有一个大家庭。我的父亲是医生。我的母亲是教师。我有两个哥哥和一个妹妹。我们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。每个周末，我们一起去公园。

sentences.english: I have a big family.
My father is a doctor.
My mother is a teacher.
I have two brothers and one sister.
sentences.chinese: 我有两个哥哥和一个妹妹。

sentences.english: We live in a small house near the park.
sentences.chinese: 我们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。

articles.title: My School
articles.english: I go to school every day. My school is big and beautiful. I have many friends at school. We study English, Math, and Science. I like my English class the most. My teacher is very kind and patient.
articles.chinese: 我每天都去上学。我的学校又大又漂亮。我在学校有很多朋友。我们学习英语、数学和科学。我最喜欢英语课。我的老师非常友善和耐心。

We study English, Math, and Science.
sentences.chinese: 我们学习英语、数学和科学。

sentences.english: I like my English class the most.

articles.title: My Hobbies
articles.english: I have many hobbies. I like playing basketball and swimming. I also enjoy reading books and watching movies. On weekends, I usually go to the gym or play with my friends. My favorite hobby is playing the guitar.
articles.chinese: 我有很多爱好。我喜欢打篮球和游泳。我也喜欢读书和看电影。在周末，我通常去健身房或和朋友一起玩。我最喜欢的爱好是弹吉他。
